image_requests.title: Member Celebration
image_requests.detail: A new member, hands wrapped for the first time, standing in front of the heavy bag with a quiet, proud smile. Warm gym light, genuine moment, no staged action.

image_requests.title: Technique

image_requests.title: Internal Game

sprint.comment: Content sprint — 200 Higgsfield credits ($12), TOPPED UP 2026-06-02. Two tracks 50/50 (Logan animated + Maya BR content), gated by a CALIBRATION phase FIRST so we never batch-burn output that doesn't look like Paul/Logan or hold up. reed-generate.js runs against this; DRY-by-default, --go to spend, stop at reserve. Still=2cr, Kling clip=6cr.
sprint.status: READY. Higgsfield topped up. AWAITING: (1) Paul confirms Maya's 5 pillars + cadence in maya-content-plan.json, (2) Paul says go on Phase-0 calibration. Then: auth Higgsfield MCP -> calibrate -> on approval, scale both tracks batch-reviewed.

discipline.calibrate_first: NO batch generation until Phase 0 calibration passes Paul's likeness/quality review. This is the answer to 'don't generate a bunch that doesn't look like me.'
discipline.batch_review: generate in batches of 2-4 -> Telegram -> Paul keeps/regens -> only the proven recipe scales
discipline.budget: 200cr total, hard reserve, every keeper flows through Flow 1 (gate -> Maya caption -> publish-ready)

sprint.expected_keepers: ~10 Logan animated clips + 3 freq-state stills (Track A) + ~30 BR content images (Track B), all captioned + publish-ready, for $12.
pre_run_checklist: Auth Higgsfield MCP + flip tools.json Higgsfield statuses depleted->live
Pick the single cleanest full-body Logan still + one corpus motion-ref for calibration
Run Phase 0 (2 gens, 12cr) -> Telegram -> Paul approves likeness
Only then: Track A boxing clips + Track B Maya images, batched

tracks.title: Phase 0 Calibration
tracks.focus: 2 test Logan clips on the BEST inputs (cleanest full-body Logan still from ~/reed-dump/logan-stills/ + one clean ~/boxing-corpus/ motion-ref), via Higgsfield Kling motion-control.
tracks.gate: Send both to Paul's Telegram. PROCEED only if he confirms likeness + quality. If off-model: adjust recipe (different still / settings / soul-id 2a825762 long-dreadlocks) and re-test BEFORE any scaling. Calibration credits come out of the Logan track.

tracks.title: Track A Logan
tracks.focus: animated Logan assets (motion-control clips), character input = the 31 existing clean stills, motion ref = boxing corpus. Includes the 12cr Phase-0 calibration.
tracks.note: 84cr of new Track-A gens + 12cr Phase-0 calibration = 96cr Logan total.

tracks.title: Track B Maya
tracks.focus: BR content stills driven by Maya's content plan (maya-content-plan.json -> maya-plan.js -> image-requests.json). Lower Paul-likeness risk than Logan; still batch-reviewed + gated + captioned.
tracks.note: ~48 image gens -> ~32 keepers after regen. Each runs the Flow-1 gate -> Maya caption -> publish-ready. Maya REQUESTS these via maya-plan.js (she's the director).
